title: B2 Module Activities
description: Activity schema for B2 level modules with increased complexity requirements: quiz questions (5-25 words), unjumble sentences (6-18 words), higher density.

question.description: Question should be 10-25 words for B2 complexity

words.description: B2 unjumble requires 6-18 words per sentence (relaxed from 10 to support natural formal phrases)

explanation.description: Required teaching feedback for this item (writer contract #8431 r3 §1c; R-19).

error.description: The incorrect word or phrase in the sentence

error_type.description: Type of correction (default: word). Use 'phrase' for multi-word corrections, 'register' for style transformations, 'construction' for grammatical structures.

correction.description: The correct word or phrase (alternative to 'answer')

error_ref.description: The E- learner-error record this item is drawn from; its `incorrect` text appears in `sentence` and its `correct` text is the correction (writer contract #8431 r3 §1c).

essay-response-b2.description: Long-form writing task with model answer and rubric - B2 requires 150+ words

critical-analysis-b2.description: Deep analysis of a text or concept - B2 requires more sophisticated analysis

target_text.description: The text or excerpt to analyze

focus_points.description: Key elements to analyze (e.g. tone, bias, historical context)

comparative-study-b2.description: Comparison of two or more texts/concepts

authorial-intent-b2.description: Evaluation of author's purpose and techniques

reading-b2.description: Reading comprehension task with external resource
